items.source:
It’s best to use l2_norm similarity when your embeddings contain information about
the count or measure of specific things, and your embedding model uses the same
similarity metric.
items.translation: 当您的嵌入包含关于特定事物数量或度量的信息，且您的嵌入模型使用相同的相似度度量时，最好使用 l2_norm 相似度。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source:
Choose the method to calculate the similarity between the vector embedding in a Vector
Search index and the vector embedding in a Vector Search query. See
https://docs.couchbase.com/server/current/search/child-field-options-reference.html for
more details.
items.translation: 选择一种方法来计算向量搜索索引中的向量嵌入与向量搜索查询中的向量嵌入之间的相似度。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 https://docs.couchbase.com/server/current/search/child-field-options-reference.html。

items.source: Dot product similarity is commonly used by Large Language Models (LLMs).
items.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）通常使用点积相似度。

items.source:
Dot product similarity is commonly used by Large Language Models (LLMs). Use
dot_product to get the best results with an embedding model that uses dot product
similarity.
items.translation: 点积相似度常被大型语言模型（LLM）使用。请使用 `dot_product` 以获得在使用点积相似度的嵌入模型时获得最佳结果。
